user.title: Add a game server
user.description: Any server that answers Valve's A2S query protocol: Source and GoldSrc games, plus many others such as Rust, ARK and Valheim.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address of the server.
data_description.port: Usually the game port (27015 by default). Some games, such as Rust, answer queries on a separate port.

error.cannot_connect: The server didn't answer. Check the host and query port, and that UDP traffic can reach it from Home Assistant.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between queries. Each poll is a few small UDP packets.
data_description.player_list: Sends an extra A2S_PLAYER query each poll and shows connected player names on the Players sensor. The list is never stored in history.
